description: Canonicalise Arabic text for search, matching or indexing: remove tashkeel and tatweel, fold alef/ya/ta-marbuta, unify Arabic-Indic digits, strip bidi control characters and collapse whitespace. mode=light is lossless; search adds letter folding; index also strips punctuation so the result can be used as a dedup key.

mode.description: light = whitespace/digits/bidi cleanup; search = + tashkeel removal and letter folding; index = + punctuation stripped.

name: text_normalize
title: Normalize Arabic text
